svg.title: Kodak Portra 800 — spektrafilm profile graph
svg.desc: Kodak Portra 800 profile: R-, G-, and B-sensitive spectral log sensitivity; stored characteristic density curves; and C (cyan), M (magenta), Y (yellow), Min (base density), and Mid (neutral midscale density) spectra. Values come directly from the Film-Juicer profile. Missing spectral samples are omitted without extrapolation; negative channel-density contributions are retained.
svg.metadata: Data: spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato. https://github.com/andreavolpato/spektrafilm License: CC BY-SA 4.0. https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/ Source: Resources/profiles/kodak_portra_800.json Source SHA-256: 7cacbd9855ec61a76086e08c92deae0d48fd9ee97606ca6eaede1611c366066d Modified 2026-09-06: plot stored log_sensitivity and density_curves directly; plot channel_density[:, 0:3] as C/M/Y, base_density as Min, and midscale_neutral_density as Mid. Missing samples are gaps; no clipping, extrapolation, or normalization of source values. Revised labels, legends, and theme colors. Profile data and model parameters are unmodified.
svg.text: Color negative film · reference illuminant D55 · Status M densitometry
R / G / B layers · D−Dmin reference 0.2
C / M / Y contributions + Min / Mid references
C / M / Y = cyan / magenta / yellow contributions · Min = processed unexposed medium · Mid = neutral midscale reference
Missing spectral samples are left blank; negative dye contributions are retained. Both spectral-density panels use the same scale.
Data: spektrafilm by Andrea Volpato · CC BY-SA 4.0 · plotted directly from the bundled profile
